info.title: Api
info.description:
Sun and Moon positions, day events, crossings and alignments from JPL DE440. Every response carries provenance (implementation, ephemeris, DE440 blocks read, compute time, cache tiers) and, for /v1/position, /v1/day, /v1/crossing and /v1/alignment, a conventions block with every threshold, horizon, refraction input and geoid value used.

Changes on 2026-10-29 (API correctness pass):
1. /v1/day rise and set now depend on height. An explicit `height` is metres above the WGS-84 ellipsoid (unchanged meaning), and the sea-horizon dip is taken from the height above mean sea level (EGM96). Example: in New York `height=0` is ≈ 33 m above sea level, so sunrise is ≈ 1 min earlier and sunset ≈ 1 min later than before. Pass `heightRef=msl` for a height above sea level (iOS `altitude`, maps); omit `height` to stand at sea level, which gives the previous times (Sun within 1 ms).
2. `apparentAltitude` in /v1/position is now `number | null`: refraction is applied down to the observer's horizon (default the sea horizon, −dip) and the value is null below it or below −1.6963°. It used to repeat the true altitude below −1°. One refraction model now serves every endpoint (34′ at the horizon), so apparent altitudes are 1.3 % of the refraction lower than Skyfield's Bennett (0.45′ at 0°, 0.07′ at 10°), and /v1/crossing at apparent 0° (upper limb) equals /v1/day's sunrise.
3. Unknown query parameters are rejected with 400 InvalidRequest (kind UnknownParameter, with the allowed list). They used to be ignored.
4. New: /v1/crossing; on /v1/day `temperature`, `pressure`, `horizon` (sea | geometric | degrees), `horizonProfile`, `limb`; `heightRef` everywhere; `altitudeRate` and `azimuthRate` (°/min) in positions; observer heightMsl and geoidUndulation.
5. New (2026-10-29): /v1/track, the sampled Sun and Moon azimuth / altitude / apparent altitude over a UTC grid in one immutable answer (what the homepage draws its paths from).

Changes on 2026-10-30 (round-2 feedback):
6. /v1/alignment: `heightRef` (observer) and `targetHeightRef`, each ellipsoid (default) | msl, as on /v1/crossing; `target` echoes the target's heights and geoid undulation; every track point has `altitudeRate`, `azimuthRate` (°/min, as /v1/position), `heightEllipsoid`, `heightMsl`, `geoidUndulation`; a `conventions` block. BEHAVIOUR CHANGE: without `observerHeight` the eye is now on the geoid (heightMsl 0, as on every other endpoint); it used to be 0 m above the ellipsoid (≈ 33 m below sea level in New York).
7. `include=sun,phase` on /v1/alignment (per track point and pass) and /v1/crossing (per crossing): the Sun's azimuth, true and apparent altitude seen from that point, and the Moon's phase.
8. `aim=center|upper|lower|litCentroid` on /v1/alignment and /v1/crossing (litCentroid: the Moon's lit-area centroid, (4r/3π)(1 − cos i) towards the bright limb), with aimOffset/aimAngle per point; /v1/position moon.brightLimbAngleFromVertical (clockwise from the local vertical, topocentric). BEHAVIOUR CHANGE: none for existing queries (aim defaults to center).
9. New: /v1/sightline (the sight line's height above sea level against distance, with Earth curvature and k = 0.13 refraction, and obstacle clearances). /docs is plain HTML (no JavaScript needed); /llms.txt; the Scalar reference moved to /docs/interactive.
10. New: POST /v1/alignment/search — every pass in [start, end) (≤ 400 days) during which the alignment standing point lies inside a standing region (GeoJSON Polygon / MultiPolygon with holes, or a bbox), with exact entry and exit points (solved on the track to 1 mm, not sampled), the Moon's azimuth / altitude / illumination and the Sun's altitude per pass, optional filters (minIlluminated, maxSunAltitude) and include=sun,phase. Candidates come from the target's elevation band over the whole region, not one representative elevation. Computed per 30-day window (GET /v1/alignment/search/window, immutable and cached), so overlapping scans share work.

height.description: Metres above the WGS-84 ellipsoid (same as heightEllipsoid; kept for compatibility).

heightMsl.description: Metres above the EGM96 geoid (≈ mean sea level).

geoidUndulation.description: EGM96 N, metres: heightEllipsoid = heightMsl + geoidUndulation.

heightRef.description: What the request's height was measured from; default = no height given, the observer is on the geoid.

apparentAltitude.description: Refracted altitude, degrees; null when it would lie below the observer's horizon or the refraction model's floor (conventions.refraction.validFrom). CHANGED 2026-10-29: was always a number, and repeated the true altitude below −1°.

altitudeRate.description: d(altitude)/dt, degrees per minute (true altitude; symmetric difference over ±10 s).

azimuthRate.description: d(azimuth)/dt, degrees per minute (symmetric difference over ±10 s).

apparentAltitude.description: Refracted altitude, degrees; null when it would lie below the observer's horizon or the refraction model's floor (conventions.refraction.validFrom). CHANGED 2026-10-29: was always a number, and repeated the true altitude below −1°.

altitudeRate.description: d(altitude)/dt, degrees per minute (true altitude; symmetric difference over ±10 s).

azimuthRate.description: d(azimuth)/dt, degrees per minute (symmetric difference over ±10 s).

brightLimbAngleFromVertical.description: Bright limb seen from this observer: degrees clockwise from the local vertical (the direction towards the zenith) as the observer sees the sky, i.e. towards increasing azimuth; topocentric (phase.brightLimbAngle is geocentric, from celestial north through east). = 360° − (χ − q) with χ the topocentric bright-limb position angle and q the parallactic angle. null at the zenith.

validFrom.description: Lowest apparent altitude that gets a value: max(horizon, the model floor −1.6963°). Below it apparentAltitude is null.

altitude.description: Apparent altitude of the horizon, degrees (null for a profile).

dip.description: Sea-horizon dip, degrees: √(1 − k)·acos(R/(R + heightMsl)), k = terrestrialRefractionK, R = 6 371 008.8 m.

encoding.description: Canonical r1 encoding: the cache key part for the region (window GETs carry it).

geoidUndulation.description: EGM96 N over the region's vertices, metres.

time.description: Midpoint of the pass's first entry and last exit; standingPoint, moon, sunAlt, sun and phase are at this instant.

enter.description: Where and when the standing point crosses into the region (a point on a region edge).

segments.description: Each in-region interval of the ground track, in time order (piers and inlets split a pass).

standingPoint.description: The alignment standing point at `time` (may lie between segments, outside the region).

az.description: The Moon's azimuth from the standing point, degrees true.

alt.description: The Moon's apparent (refracted) altitude from the standing point, degrees.

sunAlt.description: The Sun centre's true altitude from the standing point, degrees (twilight convention: −6/−12/−18).

passes.description: Passes whose first entry lies in [start, end) and that pass the filters, in time order.

reference.description: The region's bbox centre, where the scan looks at the body.

distanceM.description: Nearest and farthest region points from the target, metres (exact WGS-84 geodesics).

elevation.description: The target's apparent elevation over the whole region at the eye height, degrees: the band the body's apparent altitude must be in.

azimuth.description: Forward azimuths from the region to the target, degrees true.

band.description: The same band for the body seen from the reference point, as true altitude, margins included.

cache.description: Workers Caching status of this window's GET (HIT, MISS, …; LOCAL when computed in-process).

counters.description: Summed over the windows computed for this answer (cache hits report the counts of the run that filled them).

height.description: Height of the point to frame (e.g. the figure's middle), metres; see heightRef.

heightRef.description: What target.height is measured from: ellipsoid (default) or msl (EGM96).

items.description: [lon, lat] in degrees (a third element, altitude, is ignored).

anyOf.description: [west, south, east, north], degrees (RFC 7946 bbox order); no antimeridian crossing.

region.description: Where you can stand: a GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon (holes allowed; a Feature wrapping one is accepted) or a bbox. Edges are straight lines in (lon, lat) (RFC 7946 §3.1.1); insideness is even-odd per polygon. At most 1 000 vertices and 100 rings, ≤ 50 km across, ≤ 100 km from the target and not containing it. Coordinates are quantised to 1e-7° (≤ 1.1 cm).

observerHeight.description: Eye height, metres; see heightRef. Default: the eye on the geoid (heightMsl 0).

heightRef.description: What observerHeight is measured from: ellipsoid (default) or msl, in which case the eye is observerHeight + N(P) at every standing point P.

end.description: Passes whose first entry lies in [start, end); at most 400 days.

aim.description: Which point of the disc sits on the target (as /v1/alignment): center (default), upper, lower, litCentroid (Moon).

include.description: Extra context per pass: sun (azimuth, true and apparent altitude) and/or phase (the Moon's full phase block).

minIlluminated.description: Keep passes whose Moon illuminated fraction (at the pass time) is at least this, 0–1.

maxSunAltitude.description: Keep passes whose Sun centre true altitude (at the pass time, from the standing point) is at most this, degrees; e.g. −4 for a dark sky.

schema.description: The region in the canonical r1 encoding (the POST response's region.encoding).
Window start: a multiple of 30 days since 1970-01-01T00:00Z; the window is [start, start + 30 d).

counters.description: Work counts: scanEvaluations, spans, spanSeconds, trackEvaluations, crossings, refineEvaluations, segments, anomalies (0 unless an invariant failed), maxSagittaM.

declination.description: Magnetic declination, degrees, east positive. Magnetic bearing = true bearing − declination.

inValidityWindow.description: WMM2025 is valid 2025.0–2030.0; outside it the secular variation is extrapolated.

magneticDeclination.description: WMM2025 at the observer, height 0, now; east positive. Full precision (was rounded to 0.01° before 2026-10-29): the same value /v1/magnetic gives for lat/lon now.

observationStale.description: Observation older than 75 minutes (METARs are hourly).

distanceKm.description: Great-circle distance from the observer (sphere of radius 6 371.0088 km).

true.description: Initial great-circle bearing from the observer to the station, degrees true, [0, 360).

magnetic.description: The same bearing, degrees magnetic (true − WMM2025 declination at the observer).

directionDegTrue.description: Direction the wind blows from, degrees true; null when calm or variable.

orMore.description: Reported as N+ (e.g. 10+): at least N.

fetchedAt.description: When this Worker last confirmed the feed with aviationweather.gov (200 or 304).

stale.description: Older than the 60 s fresh window (served while a refresh runs, or because upstream failed).

tier.description: Workers Caching status of the feed fetch, lower-cased cf-cache-status (hit, updating = served stale while it refreshes, miss/expired = fetched from aviationweather.gov, revalidated = 304 from upstream); stale-on-error = the feed fetch failed and this isolate's last copy answered; none = no cache (dev).
